subject: RE: CareNova — security add-on split: implementation fee vs monthly credits
messages:
From: Alex Kelly <alex.kelly@carenovahealth.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.com, procurement@carenovahealth.com
Cc: Lisa Kaplan <lisa.kaplan@carenovahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: CareNova ask: breakdown for HIPAA deployment (audit logs / KMS / residency)

Hi Aditya —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement and legal asked for a clear pricing split for the security/compliance items we discussed so we can finalize an internal ask. Specifically: audit log retention tiers & per-GB pricing, KMS/HSM (one-time onboarding vs annual seat), and US residency vs multiregion (we'd like pricing for US-only and US+EU).

We are considering a 3-year commitment with a 6-month pilot. Our CFO is pushing for implementation costs to be amortized into monthly credits rather than an upfront SOW. Can you provide: 1) an itemized quote that shows both models (upfront implementation fee vs amortized monthly credit), 2) recommended commit level to secure a 20% concession on compliance fees, and 3) evidence delivery cadence (SOC2 artifacts, attestation timeline) for our security review.

We need a simple single-page summary for legal by 2/17. Can you loop in pricing and CS folks?

Appreciate it,
Alex
Procurement — CareNova Health

---

From: aditya.rao@redwood.com
To: Alex Kelly <alex.kelly@carenovahealth.com>, procurement@carenovahealth.com
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 11 Feb 2028 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CareNova ask: breakdown for HIPAA deployment (audit logs / KMS / residency)

Hi Alex —

Thanks — this is a great framing. Attached is a first-pass itemized sheet (Redwood_Compliance_Breakdown_Q1_2028.xlsx) and a short SOW stub (CareNova_SOW_v1.pdf). High level options we suggest: 

- Option A (Upfront SOW + lower recurring): One-time implementation fee covering HSM provisioning, residency setup, and SOC2 evidence ingest (recommended when you need a clean accounting separation). Upfront fee: $120,000; recurring compliance bundle: $0.035/GB-month for audit log retention (90d); KMS/HSM license: $18,000/year (per HSM cluster).

- Option B (Amortized credits into monthly billing): Implementation fee converted to monthly credit spread over first 12 months of the term. Example: $120k amortized = $10k/month credit against recurring compliance charges. This reduces cash outlay but keeps operational treatment simpler for you. Recurring compliance rates see a ~8% premium in amortized model (for administrative cost).

- Residency split: US-only deployment has no residency surcharge; US+EU (dual-residency) adds a flat $6k/month data sovereignty surcharge to cover standing capacity and attestation requirements.

Discounting: to reach a ~20% concession on the total compliance line we recommend a 36-month commit at a minimum with a 1.25x forecasted monthly throughput commit. That gets you negotiation space for both the surcharge and HSM license pricing.

I'll have Ben pull exact amortization numbers and a short one-pager for legal by Monday. cc'ing Lauren on contract/redline questions.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Head of Commercial — Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Compliance_Breakdown_Q1_2028.xlsx (pricing model), CareNova_SOW_v1.pdf (draft SOW)

From: ben.carter@redwood.com
To: Alex Kelly <alex.kelly@carenovahealth.com>, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 13 Feb 2028 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CareNova ask: amortization worked example + SLA note

On Sat, Feb 11, 2028 at 10:03 AM aditya.rao@redwood.com wrote:
> High level options we suggest: 
>
> - Option A (Upfront SOW + lower recurring)
> - Option B (Amortized credits into monthly billing)

Alex — quick worked example to make the decision easier:

Assumptions: 12-month pilot (3 months ramp), 36-month total term, expected audit log ingest 1.2 TB/month.

Upfront SOW model:
- Implementation: $120,000 (one-time)
- Monthly compliance recurring: $0.035/GB => ~$42/month per TB => ~ $42,000/month for 1.2TB (audit logs) [note: actual billable GBs based on ingest + retention].

Amortized model (12-month amortization of $120k):
- Monthly credit: $10,000/month for months 1–12 applied to compliance recurring charges
- Net first-year cashflow impact: Credits reduce initial cash, but effective per-GB rate increases by ~8% across the amortization window due to administrative uplift.

SLA & fallback: We can include a targeted latency SLA for audit log retrieval and a contractual fallback that triggers use of a secondary seated HSM in a nearby region for 2-hour failover. That would be part of the SOW (implementation hours included).

I'll flag that the amortized path needs clearer acceptance criteria in SOW to avoid disputes around scope of work vs operational costs.

Best,
Ben Carter
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

From: Lisa Kaplan <lisa.kaplan@carenovahealth.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@carenovahealth.com
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CareNova ask: amortization worked example + SLA note

Thanks — helpful detail. A few legal/finance redlines we need clarified before 2/17: 

1) Evidence delivery cadence: we need SOC2 artifacts within 30 days of contract signature and quarterly attestations thereafter. Can you commit to that in the SOW?
2) HSM ownership: is the HSM an on-prem seat we license, or is Redwood providing a managed HSM? If managed, we need a clause on key custody and separate customer key export controls.
3) If we take the amortized credit route, how will cancellations / early termination be handled? Finance prefers the implementation cost remain refundable on a pro-rata basis if we terminate before month 13.

Also, is there flexibility on the residency surcharge if we commit to a 48-month term? Looking for a pathway to reduce the $6k/month.

Appreciate quick clarifications so legal can advise the CFO.

Regards,
Lisa Kaplan
Sr. Counsel — CareNova Health

From: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
To: Lisa Kaplan <lisa.kaplan@carenovahealth.com>, Alex Kelly <alex.kelly@carenovahealth.com>, ben.carter@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com, procurement@carenovahealth.com
Date: Mon, 18 Feb 2028 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CareNova — clarifications on evidentiary cadence and termination (SOW stub attached)

Hi Lisa / Alex —

Thanks for the clear asks. Quick answers in-line then next steps below.

1) Evidence cadence: We confirm SOC2 artifact delivery within 30 days of signature and quarterly attestations thereafter. We will include a playbook appendix for evidence ingestion (SOC2_evidence_summary.zip attached) and a 10-business-day SLA for ad-hoc evidence requests up to agreed limits.

2) HSM model: Redwood provides a managed HSM cluster in your chosen residency. Keys remain customer-owned; we support key export controls and will include an explicit KMS key custody clause in the SOW. If you prefer a customer-managed HSM, we can provide deployment instructions and a reduced service fee (license-only model).

3) Amortization & termination: If you choose amortized credits, remaining unused credit at termination will be treated pro-rata and refunded if termination is for convenience within the first 12 months; if termination is for cause, refunds follow the carve-outs in the master services agreement. We'll add a clear termination schedule in the SOW.

Residency surcharge: For a 48-month commit we can step down the US+EU surcharge to $3k/month for months 13–48. To get to the $6k -> $0 target would require a seat-level HSM purchase and a multi-customer pooling agreement which is out of scope for a single-customer contract.

Next steps: If this is acceptable we will: 1) update CareNova_SOW_v1.pdf with the evidence cadence appendix, HSM custody clause, and termination refund schedule; 2) provide a one-page amortization summary for your CFO; 3) prepare a DocuSign envelope for the 36 vs 48-month options (link to follow).

I'll prepare the SOW update and the simple one-pager by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Legal Operations — Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: SOC2_evidence_summary.zip, updated SOW to follow.
